name: butter_my_biscuit (clone)
description:
Trying to find the right words to express how you feel about that someone special?  You're in luck, my friend, behold the "You're the Butter to My Biscuit" candle – a deliciously scented testament to the perfect pairing.  Salty, sweet, and utterly irresistible, just like that someone in your life.

This will make a perfect gift for Valentine's day! Light it up, breathe in the delightful aroma, and remember that even when life throws you a soggy bottom, you've got someone who complements you perfectly.  Because sometimes, all you need is a little bit of salty, sweet, and utterly irresistible goodness to remind you that you're not just a biscuit, you're a damn *fine* biscuit.

main_label.text:
You're the butter
to my biscuit
